requirement.original: Fix Issue #3 - Subagent sidechain envelopes not being sent to the app. When clicking an Agent/Task tool card in the happy-app sidebar, you only see prompt, tool-call-start, tool-call-end. You CANNOT see the subagent's internal operations.
requirement.clarified: Forward isSidechain=true messages from Claude's JSONL session file to the server, extending the existing isMeta forwarding pattern in sessionScanner and claudeRemoteLauncher. Add UUID-based deduplication and remove the synthetic sidechain root.
requirement.what: Forward sidechain messages from JSONL to server; add dedup; remove fake sidechain root
requirement.why: Subagent internal operations (child tool calls, text, thinking) are invisible in the app sidebar because they are only written to JSONL, not forwarded to the server

included: sessionScanner.ts: add isSidechain forwarding in sendExisting=false path
claudeRemoteLauncher.ts: add sentSidechainUuids Set for dedup
claudeRemoteLauncher.ts: extend meta-scanner callback to forward isSidechain messages
claudeRemoteLauncher.ts: reset dedup set in finally block
excluded: reducer.ts - Phase 4 sidechain processing already works
Recovery-mode scanner (sendExisting=true path) - already sends all messages

success_criteria: App sidebar shows subagent internal operations when clicking Agent/Task tool card
Child tool calls (WebSearch, Read, Bash etc.) appear as child messages
Subagent text output appears as child messages
No duplicate messages in the sidebar
constraints: Must not change sessionProtocolMapper.ts or any app-side code
Must follow existing isMeta forwarding pattern for consistency
Must handle deduplication since SDK may emit some sidechain messages via stdout

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Agent/Task tool sidebar shows only prompt, tool-call-start, tool-call-end; message.children array is empty
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Claude SDK stream-json stdout does NOT emit sidechain messages. They are only written to the JSONL file with isSidechain=true. The CLI does not forward these JSONL-only messages to the server.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural gap, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The original implementation only handled SDK stdout messages. isMeta forwarding was added later as a special case but isSidechain was never added alongside it.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The entire downstream pipeline (mapper, normalizer, reducer, UI) is ready to render sidechain messages but receives none because the CLI never sends them
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since Agent/Task tool support was added. isMeta pattern was added in commit 925f5960 (upstream merge) but isSidechain was not included.
